diagnosed the mismatch: pnpm forwards the literal '--' from 'pnpm test:e2e -- --reporter=json' to playwright, whose parser treats it as end-of-options and demotes --reporter=json to a positional file filter, so the config's list reporter stayed in effect and no JSON was ever produced
fixed the invocation to 'pnpm test:e2e --reporter=json' with PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_NAME pointed at logs/verify/playwright.json
unlink the report before the run so a stale green report cannot outlive a failing one
